audit.whatIsWrong: Chart gave Neeko level 1 and level 6 while every prose field on the page said Tryndamere owns the lane, and the header called it TRICKY at 7.5/10 in a matchup he wins 53.58% of 614 games.
audit.why: The already-audited mirror set rows 0, 1 and 4 to Tryndamere / Tryndamere / Skill. Level 1 Neeko has one 800-range seed and no escape; level 6 is a coin-flip on whether Pop Blossom lands, not her level.
audit.corrected: Tryndamere, Tryndamere, Tryndamere, Tryndamere, Skill, Tryndamere, Tryndamere with ratings 6,6,6,6,5,7,7 in matched pairs; difficulty realigned to EVEN 5/10.

audit.whatIsWrong: Pop Blossom's cooldown was never given and the page leaned on an unverified '1.5s wind-up' as the whole answer to her ultimate.
audit.why: Pop Blossom is 120/105/90s at 600 range and its preparation is hidden while Neeko is disguised — so the tell the page tells you to watch for is exactly the tell she can hide. Undying Rage is 120/100/80s and costs nothing.
audit.corrected: Real cooldowns written in; the hidden-prep condition stated so the advice is not built on a tell that can vanish.

audit.whatIsWrong: Inherent Glamour was described as her 'only escape', and Tangle-Barbs was given no range, cooldown or growth condition.
audit.why: Riot's text: Inherent Glamour is a disguise that breaks on casting damaging spells, on taking immobilizing CC, or on the disguise taking its healthbar in damage — it is information, not mobility. Tangle-Barbs is 1000 range on 12/11.5/11/10.5/10s and becomes larger, faster and longer-rooting after it passes through a champion, so it is worse when it hits a minion-line target first.
audit.corrected: Both rewritten into spikes[0] and the ability lines.

audit.whatIsWrong: Neeko is female; the page referred to her as 'him' and 'he' throughout.
audit.why: Pronoun errors read as a page written about a different champion and cost trust on a paid product.
audit.corrected: Fixed in every field where the length band allowed.

edits.before: You dominate this stretch: Neeko is a squishy immobile mage whose only escape is passive Inherent Glamour disguise, so E in whenever her E Tangle-Barbs root is on cooldown and force crit trades she can't answer. E in whenever Tangle-Barbs sits on its 10-12s cooldown and force crit trades she cannot answer. Blooming Burst poke is real, so Bloodlust it off and hold the CS lead.

edits.before: Her R Pop Blossom needs a 1.5s wind-up, so the moment she channels it, E Spinning Slash out or pop R Undying Rage — she has no other burst that threatens you, and dodging her ult effectively removes her whole kill combo.
edits.after: Pop Blossom knocks up then stuns on a 120/105/90s cooldown, and its preparation is hidden while she is disguised — treat any odd-looking ally model as her. E out or pop Undying Rage the instant it starts; dodging it removes her kill combo.

edits.before: Level 1 is even as both of you just farm, but Neeko has no way to threaten a squishy start against your sustain, so contest CS freely.
edits.after: Level 1 is yours — Neeko holds one 800-range seed and no way to threaten you against Bloodlust sustain, so contest CS freely.
